infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Geospector uses the camera to record GPS-tagged video and capture photos.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Geospector uses the microphone to record audio with your GPS-tagged video.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Geospector uses your location to tag each video frame and photo with precise GPS coordinates.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Geospector uses your location to continuously tag video frames with GPS coordinates, even when the screen is locked.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Geospector uses Bluetooth to discover and connect to GoPro and other external cameras.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Geospector uses the local network to control connected cameras over Wi-Fi.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to connect to Bluetooth cameras.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use your location to join camera Wi-Fi networks.
